extension.news: Menus and widgets now use Pirate Shortcuts, preserving existing customizations when Skin Shortcuts updates. Includes the latest blue progress percentages and spotlight styling. Updated Pirate artwork and bundled Pirate UI Sounds. Simplified the home spotlight and widget episode labels. Matched Search to the navy sidebar and beveled blue headers. Removed the accent stripe from search result headings. Rebuilt the media details page with an opaque navy panel and a compact action row. Show details now open Episodes consistently from Home and Search. Episode labels use S1: E2 spacing.
